properties.markdownProperty:
This document is a **catalogue of the object archetypes** in the PROTEUS *Basic* profile. Each archetype has its own section with:
1. a **Comment** that explains what the archetype is for and which properties it has, and 2. a **realistic example** of the archetype in use.
All examples come from one fictional project: the requirements specification for **BiblioUS**, a new loan management system for the University of Seville Library. Because every example belongs to the same project, they can trace to each other (a stakeholder *works for* an organization, a meeting lists its *attenders*, a paragraph *depends on* a glossary item, and so on). This shows how the archetypes fit together in a real document.
Use the document as a quick reference when you start a new project with the Basic profile, or as a starting point you can copy and adapt.
